name: Jennifer Haltom Doan
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property Litigation attorney in Texarkana, Texas

education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: As a partner at Haltom & Doan, Jennifer Haltom Doan serves clients throughout the state of Texas. She focuses her practice on litigation involving intellectual property, antitrust, environmental issues and civil matters; as well as personal injury (representing victims and defendants). Ms. Doan received a Bachelor of Business Administration from Abilene Christian University, graduating cum laude. She went on to graduate with honors, earning a Juris Doctor from The University of Texas School of Law.

Certified in civil trial law and personal injury trial law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Ms. Doan has served as lead counsel, handling a diverse array of litigation matters on behalf of people and businesses. She has achieved high rates of success in defending her clients; she obtained favorable verdicts in patent infringement cases on behalf of Yahoo! Inc. and Amazon.com, Inc. Ms. Doan handles cases involving complex business controversies, class actions, pharmaceutical litigation, environmental and toxic tort claims, and product liability.

Ms. Doan's commitment to providing quality legal services, while maintaining high standards of ethics, has garnered her the respect of her clients and peers alike. She has received the highest possible rating of AV Preeminent* from Martindale-Hubbell. Among the awards and recognitions that she has received, Ms. Doan has been named a Go-To Lawyer and B2B Lawyer by Fortune magazine, and a Best Attorney in Texarkana by Four States Living magazine.

Beyond her work in the courtroom, Ms. Doan is actively involved in the legal community. She is a member of numerous professional associations, including the American Board of Trial Advocates, the State Bar of Texas, the Arkansas Bar Association and the American Bar Association.

* AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
